note: Inputs of every file under data/. Raw downloads are kept in the git-ignored .cache/ folder; scripts/fetch_sources.py downloads them again and records the same fields in .cache/<name>/source.json. No source needs a login or key. atlas files are republished every night under a new resource id, so `url` is the link that was valid at `retrieved`; fetch_sources.py looks the current link up on `landing_page` by file name.
attribution: Source: opentransportdata.swiss (timetable and atlas master data); Federal Office of Topography swisstopo (municipal boundary).
